resources.string: Optional provider settings stay absent until supplied. Region is literal, unverified text; these controls do not contact a provider or resolve a credential.
Preserve the exact region text. A supplied empty string or whitespace is different from not supplied; this is not a verified location.
Use only an allowed opaque secret reference, such as secret://provider/key. Never paste a credential value.
Use an admitted URI without user information in its authority. Its spelling is preserved; the address is not opened or verified.

Pending typed input is kept only in bounded private recovery. Recovery excludes invalid credential references and recognized URI user information. Restored input must be reviewed and never proves that a save completed.
Enter valid Unicode text, or clear Supply to leave the field absent.
Enter an allowed secret reference, or clear Supply. Do not enter a credential value.
Enter an admitted URI without authority user information, or clear Supply.
This field exceeds the local editor limit. Shorten it before saving.
